children: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd Sponsored GDR Pfd (KRX:005930) is navigating a tense mix of activism and legal scrutiny while scaling semiconductor and smartphone leadership—doubling HBM4 output, trialing Tesla AI5 chips on 2nm, pursuing massive capex, and drawing buyback calls amid market swings.
Previous Week Recap
Repurchase Demand For GDRs
: A South Korean hedge fund urged Samsung Electronics Co Ltd Sponsored GDR Pfd (005930) to repurchase and cancel its preferred GDRs, pressing for a buyback to boost valuation.
Intraday Swing, Mixed Reactions
: Samsung Electronics (005930) swung intraday: rose ~4.98% on chip rally and record chip exports, later dipped ~0.2% amid Asian weakness before Fed/BOJ meetings, then up 0.7% after prior 4.05% drop.
HBM4 Output Expansion Plans
: Samsung Electronics (005930) plans to double HBM4/HBM4E output next year; outsourced glass substrate cleaning to rise from 20,000 to 50,000 wafers/month.
Trial Production Of Tesla AI5
: Samsung Electronics (005930) started trial production of Tesla’s AI5 chips on its 2nm Taylor, Texas line; yield checks are underway and full supply is slated for next year.
Massive Semiconductor Investment Plan
: Samsung Electronics (005930) plans about 2,030 trillion won in semiconductor investment through 2040 to expand memory production and AI-related chip activities.
NAND Revenue Leadership Share
: Samsung Electronics (005930) led NAND memory revenue in Q2 with ~29.3% market share per TrendForce, competing with domestic rivals CXMT and YMTC amid a global memory shortage
ITC Investigation On Audio Tech
: U.S. ITC opened an investigation naming Samsung Electronics Co Ltd Sponsored GDR Pfd (005930) over alleged covered audio technologies in electronic devices; formal ITC probe now involves Samsung.
Talks With Intel On Tie-Up
: Samsung Electronics (005930) held early talks with Intel on a potential U.S. manufacturing tie-up, exploring leasing part of Intel’s Ohio plant or a joint venture; no deal confirmed.
Profitability Shifts To Memory
: Analysts say profitability could shift from GPUs to memory next year. If hyperscalers fail to monetize capex, potential spending cuts may hit GPUs, servers and Samsung memory pricing (005930).
Smartphone Lead Restored In Q2
: Samsung Electronics (005930) regained global smartphone shipment lead in Q2 2026 with a 23% share, a 9% year-over-year shipment rise, per Counterpoint Research.
